title: Favorite old-time bass players
summary: He names Sam Nixon, Henry Kimball and Jimmy Brown as good bassists.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Bass players: lineage, tone and technique

blocks.x: That's how we got it. Who would you say is the best bass player of those old timers when you were young? Who would be your favorite, do you think? Or do you have a favorite, or did you?

Well, it was, oh, we had, let me see, Sam. Sam Nixon. Huh? Sam Nixon. Sam Nixon. Sam Nixon was a pretty good bass player. Yeah. Oak Gospel. Yeah. Well, my bass to leave for as far as I, in my book was, Henry Kimball was Thompson. See? Well, he was an actor, good musician, reason everything, you know. Jimmy Brown was a good bass player. Oh, yeah. Yeah.
Do you remember, was Jimmy Johnson older than you? I guess he was.
